title: Reproducible computational vignettes for the CRISPR-perturbation multi-omics identifiability review
description: Code and result files that regenerate the illustrative computational analyses in the review 'When does a CRISPR-perturbation result support a causal claim about a farm-animal trait? An audit of the verified editing record and a framework for method selection' (V. Asediya, 2026). All analyses run on synthetic or public data; no new experimental data were generated.
